headlines.text: Dow, S&P 500, and Nasdaq futures fall as the US-Iran war escalates and inflation jitters return.
Oil surges past $95 a barrel as the US downplays Iran diplomacy and a second key trade route is disrupted.
Fed Chair Kevin Warsh's hawkish Jackson Hole speech pushes September rate-hike odds above 50%.
Wall Street closed lower Tuesday to open September, with the S&P 500 down 0.71% and the Nasdaq off 1.03%.
ADP's August jobs report, the Fed's Beige Book, and the ISM Manufacturing PMI all land Wednesday as investors gauge the economy.
Broadcom and Snowflake report earnings after the close, with AVGO revenue seen surging 84% on AI-chip demand.
